name: Asou Kikka
source:
Likes: Hamburger, Pizza, Games.
Dislikes: Studying.

One of the three minions of [url=/c24589]Urumi[/url]. She is the Uza character of the trio. Kikka calls Urumi "Shishou" for some reason.

[Translated from Getchu]
